name: HiddenInput
description: a hidden input for including data in form submission <input type="hidden">
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: Native `<input type="hidden">` is non-interactive and not announced to assistive technology
No ARIA attributes are needed; the value is part of form submission only
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `name`: string (required) -- the form field name attribute
`...restProps`: unknown -- additional attributes spread onto the `<input>` element
